name: Drift Collective Salvage-Bead Necklace
description:
A necklace strung with beads made from salvaged materials — circuit board fragments, polished machine screws, flattened bullet casings, tumbled glass from broken displays. Each bead represents something the wearer found, survived, or chose to remember. No two necklaces are the same.

In Shelf communities where the Drift Collective's aesthetic holds influence, the Salvage-Bead Necklace functions as a wearable autobiography. People who know the code can read the beads like a timeline — this one is from the factory collapse, this one is from the year the water went bad, this one is a casing from the night everything changed.
functionality: Personal history display, community identity marker
what_it_says: Your life is written in the things you found in the wreckage, and you wear it around your neck.
story_hooks: A Salvage-Bead Necklace found on a body contains a bead made from a material that shouldn't exist in the Shelf — a fragment of Spire-exclusive alloy, suggesting the wearer had access to places their life story shouldn't include.
